name: open-overheid
description: Toolkit for Dutch and Amsterdam open government data: addresses and buildings (BAG), local regulations in force (CVDR, e.g. the APV), CBS StatLine statistics and maps for every municipality, district and neighbourhood, council meetings and documents (NotuBiz), zoning plans (PDOK/KOOP), court rulings (ECLI), official publications (KOOP SRU), Amsterdam key figures (BBGA), Woo/FOI decisions (open.amsterdam) and the Amsterdam subsidy register. Works with Gemini (Antigravity) and Claude.
